question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Esteem
solution:
The correct answer is "**Condemn**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Esteem**" refers to respect and admiration for someone or something. (सम्मान) 

 
 
• **Example**- She held her mentor in high esteem.
 
 
 
• "**Condemn**" presents the idea of expressing complete disapproval of; to criticize severely. (निन्दा करना)
 
 
• **Example**- The act was widely condemned by the international community.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "Condemn".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 4'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Notice**" denotes attention; observation. (ध्यान)
 
• "**Value**" stands for the regard that something is held to deserve; importance or worth. (महत्व)
 
• "**Regret**" signifies a feeling of sadness or disappointment over something that has happened. (पछतावा)
